note: stage C candidate task set, not run yet. Each task pairs a real closed issue/fix commit with its parent commit and its own fail-to-pass tests. The task text describes the observed bug, not the fix. windows_tests_pass is unverified until stage C actually runs npm test on Windows for that parent commit.

tasks.task: When res.send() is called with an object or array while Transfer-Encoding is already set on the response, the automatically generated ETag stops matching the actual body. Find and fix the cause in lib/response.js.

res.send() adds a Content-Length header even when a Transfer-Encoding header is already present on the response, which violates HTTP semantics. Fix lib/response.js so Content-Length is only added when Transfer-Encoding is absent.
req.acceptsCharsets() does not behave correctly for some Accept-Charset header values and argument shapes. Review lib/request.js and correct the charset negotiation.

res.redirect() writes the raw redirect target straight into the generated HTML anchor's href attribute, so a URL containing HTML-significant characters is rendered unescaped. Fix lib/response.js to render the value safely.
A route added without an HTTP method restriction fails to match incoming requests correctly. Fix the route matching in lib/router/route.js.
Routing a request through a route with a large number of layered handlers regressed and now behaves incorrectly (previously fixed, then broken again by a later change). Fix lib/router/route.js.
Dispatching a request through a router with a large stack of synchronous middleware/routes hangs instead of completing. Find and fix the cause in lib/router/index.js.
Passing null or undefined as the maxAge option to res.cookie() produces the wrong cookie expiry behavior instead of being treated as "no maxAge". Fix lib/response.js.
With the "json escape" setting enabled, sending an undefined value through res.json()/res.jsonp() is handled incorrectly. Fix lib/response.js.

lib/application.js depends on the external utils-merge package for a simple object merge; the dependency should be dropped in favor of plain object spread with equivalent merge behavior, and lib/response.js's use of the same helper updated to match.
The no-loss-of-precision rule reports a false positive on the numeric literal 0.e5. Fix the precision-loss detection in lib/rules/no-loss-of-precision.js.

getFunctionHeadLoc in lib/rules/utils/ast-utils.js does not handle TSFunctionType nodes, which breaks rules (such as max-params) that rely on it for TypeScript function type annotations. Add the missing support.

prefer-object-spread suggests an autofix for Object.assign() calls that include a __proto__ property, but applying the spread transform in that case changes the object's prototype instead of setting an own property. Make the rule ignore this case.

object-shorthand reports and autofixes a __proto__: __proto__ property to shorthand form, but shorthand __proto__ has different semantics (it sets the prototype rather than defining an own property). Make the rule skip __proto__ properties.

prefer-object-has-own's autofix produces broken code when the global Object identifier is shadowed by a local variable in scope. Fix lib/rules/prefer-object-has-own.js so the autofix accounts for shadowing.
new-cap reports a false positive for calls like Date.UTC(...) when the properties option is set to false. Fix lib/rules/new-cap.js.

no-unreachable incorrectly flags static import statements that appear after a return/throw/etc. as unreachable, even though imports are hoisted and always reachable. Fix lib/rules/no-unreachable.js to ignore them.
no-loss-of-precision reports a false positive for a numeric literal that has a trailing decimal point with no digits after it. Fix lib/rules/no-loss-of-precision.js.

prefer-template's autofix can turn a string concatenation into a template literal that is placed right after an identifier, accidentally creating a tagged template call instead of a plain template literal. Fix lib/rules/prefer-template.js so the autofix cannot produce this.

id-denylist flags identifier-like meta-property names (such as the target in new.target) as denylisted identifiers, which is not the rule's intent. Fix lib/rules/id-denylist.js to ignore meta-property names.
